margin.note: How far a budget may sit above the measured value it is set from: the larger of ratio x the value and the metric's floor, rounded up to a whole thousand bytes (counts are not rounded). Provisional; the owner decides. Builds of unchanged code measure the same bytes, so the margin is room for ordinary product changes, not noise: on the nine main runs from bf64b91f8 to 00de69100, single merges added 0.5 to 5.7 KB of route JS, which 3% of a 60 KB route (about 1.8 KB) cannot absorb.
